studies.title: Studies
studies.empty: No studies yet. Each assignment, passage or topic you work on in this project is a study.

stateOfArt.title: State of the art
stateOfArt.subtitle: The project's bibliography, prepared once for all its studies: what is required, which works exist, how each is evaluated and which ones are used. It follows the method of Eco, Vyhmeister and Fee.

stepHint.candidates: Works that could help, from every origin. The same work from several origins is a single entry and ranks higher. Evaluate each one and approve it or discard it with a reason.
stepHint.approved: The bibliography every study in the project starts with. You can add or remove works later.
stepHint.toAcquire: What is not in your library. When you get the book, upload it and link it with «I have it».
stepHint.discarded: What was discarded, with the reason, so you can explain to the professor why it was not used.

empty.candidates: No candidates yet. Press «Find candidates» to gather them from the syllabus, the catalog, your library and the project's studies, or add a work by hand.

stateOfArt.saveFailed: The state of the art could not be saved.
stateOfArt.syncHint: Approved works that are in your library are also the project's sources for conversations.

q.coversBook: Does it comment on the project's biblical book?
q.printedPages: Does the edition have printed pages?
q.hasNotes: Does it have notes and bibliography?

criteria.requirementsCourseHint: From the syllabus or the professor: required works, types and criteria. If there is no bibliography, write them yourself.
criteria.requirementsResearchHint: What you want to answer and how far the research goes.
criteria.prohibitionsHint: For example: devotional works, websites or editions without pages.
criteria.inclusionHint: Why a work enters the approved bibliography.
criteria.exclusionHint: Why a work stays out, even if it was considered.
criteria.noRepeat: Do not repeat sources across assignments
criteria.noRepeatHint: A rule of this course, not of the method: it turns on the warning for sources already used in another study of the project.
criteria.noMinimums: The work types' rubrics set no minimums.
criteria.minimumsHint: They come from the work types' rubrics; change them there.
criteria.noBooks: None yet: they come from the project's studies.
criteria.booksHint: Used to find commentaries and to know whether each one covers the book.
